reading_a.provenance: 真题母本改编（教师授权原创 2026-08-06）
reading_a.绑定: 一般现在时三单-s(have/has/ studies/ begins)/学科名词(Chinese/math/physics)/学科搭配动词
paragraphs: I am a student at Sunshine Middle School. My school day is busy but fun. In the morning, I have Chinese, math and physics. Chinese is my favorite subject. I study math every day. Math is not easy, but I like it. My classmate Tom likes physics. He studies physics very hard.

After lunch, we have geography and biology. Miss Li teaches us geography. She is kind and careful. Tom doesn't like biology. He thinks it is difficult. But I like biology because it is interesting. We do exercises in class and answer questions. Our teacher asks us to complete the homework every day.
In the evening, I finish my homework and read books. Every subject is important. I begin my study at eight and go to bed at ten. What a busy but happy school day!

reading_b.provenance: 真题母本改编（教师授权原创 2026-08-06）
reading_b.绑定: 一般现在时三单(reads/ understands/ answers)/does否定疑问/学科名词(geography/ biology)/学习动作(read/ practice/ reason)
paragraphs: Today is Friday. After school, I go to the school library with my classmate Anna. The library is quiet and clean. Anna reads a geography book. She understands it quickly. I look for a math problem book. I want to solve a difficult problem.

The librarian is Miss Green. She is careful and helpful. She answers our questions with a smile. Anna asks, "Does this library have books about biology?" Miss Green says, "Yes, it does. They are on the second shelf."

We practice reading for an hour. Miss Green tells us, "Careful reading makes you clever. Reason and practice are the keys to good study." We say thank you and leave. Every day in the library is a good day.

questions.q: Where do the students go after school?
The underlined word "clever" means ____ in Chinese.
From the passage, we can infer that the writer ____.

reading_c.provenance: 真题母本改编（教师授权原创 2026-08-06）
reading_c.绑定: 学科名词(physics/ geography/ biology)/三单(helps/ shows/ tells)/学习动作(listen/ practice/ finish)/does否定疑问
paragraphs: Students have many subjects at school, such as Chinese, math, physics, geography and biology. Every subject is useful. Math helps us think clearly. Chinese helps us read and write well. Physics tells us how things work. Geography shows us the world and its places.

How do we study subjects well? First, we listen carefully in class. Second, we ask questions when we don't understand. Third, we practice and do exercises every day. We must finish our homework on time. A good student is careful and quick.

Some students think a subject is difficult. But if we study it with a reason and keep practicing, it becomes easy. Don't give up. Every subject opens a new door for us. Study hard, and you will be happy with your grades.

questions.q: Which subject helps us think clearly?
What should students do when they don't understand?
The writer thinks a difficult subject ____.

w5.title: 根据短文内容，从方框中选出最佳句子填入文中空白处，使短文通顺连贯（有一项为多余选项）
paragraphs: Studying well is not hard. Good students have good habits. ___1___ They listen carefully and take notes. They do their homework on time and review their lessons every day.
___2___ They ask their teachers and classmates for help. Asking questions is a good way to understand a subject. A good question brings a clear answer.
Practice makes perfect. ___3___ Read and write every day. Do exercises and check your answers. Careful students always find their mistakes and fix them.
___4___ Sleep well and eat healthy food. A happy body helps your mind work well. Keep trying, and you will study better and better.
candidates: Being careful with your work helps a lot.
When they don't understand, they ask questions.
Good study habits make learning easy and fun.
Students also need rest and healthy food.
Watching TV all day is good for study.

sa.title: 阅读下面短文，回答下列问题或按要求完成句子
sa.绑定: 三单-s(studies, likes)/does否定(doesn't like)/why提问/翻译/学科名词
paragraphs: I am a student at Star Middle School. My favorite subject is English, but I also like math and physics. Every morning, I go to school at seven. I study Chinese, math and physics in the morning. My classmate Anna likes geography. She says geography is fun and easy. But she doesn't like music. She thinks it is boring.

After class, I do my homework and read English books. I want to be careful with my study. I practice English every day. My teacher says, "Practice makes perfect." I want to understand every lesson well.

questions.q: What is the writer's favorite subject?
Do you want to practice English every day like the writer? Why or why not?
questions.answer: Yes, I do. Because practice makes perfect.

questions.q: 将句子 "Practice makes perfect." 译成中文。

writing.title: 书面表达（15 分）
writing.prompt: 你叫 Li Hua，请用英语写一篇短文，介绍你的校园生活，包括你最喜欢的学科、你的一天安排，以及你同学 Tom 的学习习惯。
writing.requirements: 1. 使用本课词汇（学科名、study/read/finish/have 等学习动词）与句型（一般现在时三单 -s、does 否定疑问）；2. 约 80 词；3. 条理清楚，语句通顺。
writing.sample: My name is Li Hua. I am a student at Sunshine Middle School. My favorite subject is math. I study math every day. My classmate Tom likes physics. He studies it very hard. Every morning, I have Chinese, math and physics. In the afternoon, we have geography and biology. Tom doesn't like biology. He thinks it is difficult. But I like it because it is interesting. After class, I finish my homework and read books in the library. Tom always completes his homework on time. We both study hard. We want to understand every subject well. School life is busy but happy.
